name: Being Offended
overview: Scripture teaches that being offended is a serious matter that can harden relationships and create barriers, as a brother offended is described as harder to win than a strong city. Wisdom calls for discretion and patience, urging believers to defer anger and pass over transgressions as a mark of glory. Those who love God's law enjoy great peace and are not easily offended, reflecting a heart anchored in divine truth. Ultimately, trusting in the Lord to fight on our behalf allows us to maintain calm and avoid unnecessary strife.
